tools.name: get_postcode_details
tools.description: Get detailed open data for a single UK postcode from Postcodes UK: location, coordinates, elevation, district population and households, deprivation deciles and property prices where available.

postcode.description: A full UK postcode, for example 'SW1A 1AA' or 'M1 1AE'.

tools.name: search_postcodes
tools.description: Search Postcodes UK for UK postcodes, towns, streets and schools by name or partial postcode. Returns matching results, each with its page URL on postcodesuk.com.

query.description: A full or partial UK postcode, town, street or school name. Examples: 'SW1A', 'Manchester', 'Baker Street'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 8).
